objective: Deliver persisted child events through exact Orca Dispatch mailbox and resume SHM without disturbing other projects
invariants: Explicit workspace/attempt/Dispatch; no implicit current or cross-attempt reuse
No replay of unknown effects; persisted request before send; processing ACK remains separate
Preserve frozen snapshots and reports; only SHM lifecycle operations

queue.task: Replace terminal input wake with durable Dispatch-addressed notification; reconcile new and legacy receipts
Install only changed modules; restart SHM service only; confirmed stop/retry/resume and verify coordinator

verification: Events delivered when exact worker is live with unknown or working activity
Lost/absent receipts never permit a new send; legacy receipt reconciliation preserved
Foreign owner/incarnation, stopped/paused and other project state isolated
execution_rules: No registered goal launches as tests; SHM resume explicitly requested by user
